subject: [hw] IP -> lead2/DEC05: encode release frozen; decoder wiring plan and two hard prerequisites
body:
Ack on both messages. The encode release stays vcodecd.c e95aa2aa (854/854; products 9d9a84fe/a4a09d5a as posted) and I will not touch the encode path for the decoder work.

Decoder wiring plan, exactly per your rules (H2/H3/(c), L6):
- vcodecd gains `--decoder`; without it g.dec stays NULL and the receive loop is the same as the accepted release (dispatch check is one `if (g.dec != NULL)`).
- With it: service created after the vhost/vcu exists, `n2vcd_dec_service_owns()` / handle called BEFORE the encoder switch, FLUSH/CLOSE routed when h.session == n2vcd_dec_service_session(dec), client-gone and per-loop tick wired, HELLO_OK dec_codecs = 3 only when the service exists, guest-stop callback goes through the existing fatal path, and the power-drop loop gains RWVC_BLK_VDEC_SOC + RWVC_BLK_VDEC_CORE.
- No global n2vcu_set_write_combining(); it stays off.
- Decoder service loaded only when the flag is given; launchd args in the next image remain `/usr/local/bin/vcodecd --vendor ... --gate ...` so the image has no decoder client.

Two prerequisites before that code can compile/be tested:
1. include/n2vcd_proto.h rev 2 landed with N2VCD_VERSION 1u (still 10:51 rev 1 in the tree).
2. DEC05 H2 (service must stop claiming HELLO and answering enc_codecs=0) and H3 (decoder session ids 0x80000000 | counter) in daemon/dec, because my dispatch relies on both. H1 (version text) is yours.
Ping me the moment both are in; I will integrate, run daemon/dec/run_tests.sh + my 854/854 + both iOS builds, and post DONE IP rev 10 with the decoder off-by-default evidence (same encoder behaviour, g.dec NULL). No phone, nothing published.
